channel.title: Coastal Currents
channel.description: A bi-weekly read on coastal South Orange County real estate by Adam Boehrer, Real Estate Agent, Pacific Sotheby's International Realty, CA DRE #02419464. Dated, sourced CRMLS figures for San Clemente, Dana Point, Capistrano Beach, San Juan Capistrano and the wider South OC coast.
channel.copyright: Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's International Realty

item.title: A home that earns its keep. (July 2026)
item.dc:creator: Adam Boehrer
item.description: San Clemente's expected market time fell to 70 days from 98 a year ago, 40% of active listings have taken a price cut, and the June median sale price hit $1.89M. Plus how an owner-occupied home that earns income gets a first purchase across the line in South Orange County. By Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's International Realty.

item.title: Six months to ten weeks: the Dana Point shift. (June 2026)
item.dc:creator: Adam Boehrer
item.description: Dana Point single-family homes sold in a median 12 days in April 2026, less than half of last April's 32, with supply down to 3.1 months from 4.8 and a $2.99M median. The harbor rebuild is visibly underway. By Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's International Realty.

item.title: Peak spring, and pricing discipline is deciding everything. (May 2026)
item.dc:creator: Adam Boehrer
item.description: San Clemente single-family homes sold in a median 11 days in March 2026 at a 100.8% sale-to-list ratio, with 28% of city-wide listings taking a price cut. Why correctly priced homes move fast while high-side listings sit. By Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's International Realty.

item.title: March closed strong. Here's what that tells us about April. (April 2026)
item.dc:creator: Adam Boehrer
item.description: San Clemente single-family homes sold in a median 11 days in March 2026, down from 19 a year earlier, at a 100.8% sale-to-list ratio and a $1.81M median price. Plus Beach Road, the tightest direct-sand pocket in Capistrano Beach. By Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's International Realty.

item.title: Spring is opening with a different tone than last year. (March 2026)
item.dc:creator: Adam Boehrer
item.description: The 2026 spring buyer pool formed earlier than last year across South Orange County. This issue covers Dana Point: 18 new Del Prado Place condos in the Lantern District, Harbor Phase 3 demolition, and the Festival of Whales. By Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's International Realty.

item.title: What I'm watching as the 2026 market opens. (February 2026)
item.dc:creator: Adam Boehrer
item.description: San Clemente single-family homes took a median 53 days to sell in January 2026, up from 29 days a year earlier, with 2.1 months of supply and a $1.73M median sale price. Plus why South San Clemente owners are renovating instead of selling. By Adam Boehrer, Pacific Sotheby's International Realty.
